items.title: American Airlines Stock Slides as Jet Fuel Prices Bite
items.summary: American Airlines has been trying to close the gap with United and Delta, but its latest profit outlook risks putting it further behind. It said its adjusted earnings could range from a loss of 65 cents per share to a 65 cent per share profit this year.
